steps.name: Home
steps.goal: If Your data and AI providers is visible, tap Agree and continue to enter the local demo. Otherwise only wait for the existing session list. Do not tap the composer.
steps.done: Home shows the api-gateway folder and the existing rate limiter session.
expect: Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window

steps.name: Video in chat
steps.goal: Tap the session row that begins with Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window, in the session list. Never tap What should we work on? or any composer or keyboard control.
steps.done: The chat is open and shows a video with a Save or share button under it.

steps.name: Share sheet
steps.goal: Tap the Save or share button under the video. Do not tap the video itself.
steps.done: The iOS share sheet is open and offers Save Video.
